shares.selection_policy: latest eligible economic date; source priority; latest eligible revision; conflict => unavailable

source_valuation.share_policy: latest eligible shares outstanding by economic date and source priority; weighted average never substituted
source_valuation.fcf_definition_version: engine-fcf-1.0: operating cash flow minus reported capex
source_valuation.ev_definition: market_cap + total debt - cash and cash equivalents
source_valuation.forward_status: Not required for M1.1 closure; internal deterministic forward valuation remains deferred
source_valuation.first_open_policy: Opening price is execution observation; same-day HLC excluded

dcf_projection.formula: FCFF proxy = EBIT*(1-tax) + (forecast OCF - forecast net income) - capex
dcf_projection.limitations: Noncash, working-capital and nonoperating cash classification remain approximations; SBC is not expensed again. Unadjusted CFO-capex is never labeled FCFF.
